en: Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a panoramic view over the coastal city and harbor of Vigo, with many small boats and ships anchored in the bay. In the foreground are railway tracks and small houses surrounded by vegetation; in the distance, dense urban buildings rise along the hillside and mountains frame the background. Printed caption text appears at the top left and there is a small imprint at the bottom left.
